answer:
I gave your Porto weekend note a page. It has the flights and hotel details, the to-do checklist (you can tick items on the page) and your ideas. I haven't opened or tested it in the app.

I couldn't make the button set a reminder directly. Pages run in a sandbox that can't reach your phone's Reminders or Calendar. So the **⏰ Remind me to pack** button creates a calendar event file (`.ics`) with an alert at 20:00 on Thu 15 Oct. That's the evening before your Fri 16 Oct 07:10 flight, and the date is read from the flights line in your note. If the download is blocked, the button shows the file's text so you can copy it. Opening the file adds the event to your phone's calendar.

I picked 20:00 myself, so change it if you'd rather pack earlier or later.
